header.title: The MCU Without the Marathon
header.lede: What you need to know to watch Avengers: Doomsday, and then the whole story of Marvel's films and series, told in order. The text gives away the endings.
doom.title: Before Doomsday
doom.lede: The setup for the film: who is where, what the trailers showed and what is still unknown. Highlighted names open each one's profile. Green, throughout the page, marks what ties into Doomsday.
story.title: The complete story
story.lede: One chapter per phase, from the first Iron Man to today. Only the sagas have official names; the phase subtitles are this guide's own, except the first, which is the name of the Phase 1 collector's box set.
explore.title: Explore
explore.lede: Every film and series has a full summary of what happens. Every character, group, place, Stone and concept has a profile, their current status and what they do in each title. The green dot marks who is in Doomsday.
